Name: Shema, Son of Hebron
Summary: Son of Hebron son of Mareshah and father of Raham.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:43: Son of Hebron son of Mareshah and father of Raham.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shema stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
